feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Can Google win the AI race without killing its cash cow?
entry.summary: In late October, Google had the worst stock day in its history as a public company. The Planet Money newsletter asks: has Google been caught in "the innovator's dilemma"?

entry.title: I'm a human doctor with human intelligence. But I sure do like my AI notetaker
entry.summary: Has your doctor asked whether they can use artificial intelligence to take notes during an exam? It's very popular, and here's how to think through the pros and the cons of the new technology.

entry.title: Trump arrives in Philippines to kick off Asia trip
entry.summary: Manila is President Trump's first stop on a three-day trip that will later take him to China for historic three-way nuclear talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

entry.title: Does locking up a student's cell phone improve test scores? A new study suggests so
entry.summary: A new study of school cellphone bans finds they may help students make up for some of the learning they've lost since 2013 – a divergence from earlier study results.

entry.title: She went to college to become a social worker. Now she's joined the skilled trades
entry.summary: While the rise of AI continues to fuel the debate over whether college is worth the cost, apprenticeships in the skilled trades are having a moment, drawing in people of all backgrounds including college graduates.

entry.title: More people are getting the flu. Should you get a flu shot before you travel?
entry.summary: Thanksgiving is just around the corner, just as millions of Americans are expected to travel for the holidays. Another thing that's upon us? Cold and flu season.

entry.title: Ukraine strikes major Russian bridge with drones and missiles as aerial attacks escalate
entry.summary: A Ukrainian drone and missile attack prepared over several weeks struck a vital Russian rail and road bridge to the occupied Crimean Peninsula, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Tuesday.

entry.title: Questions about FAA funding roil Capitol Hill after nationwide ground stop
entry.summary: Three days after a communications meltdown led the FAA to ground planes, there are big questions about what happened and how much money is needed to upgrade the country's air traffic control system.

entry.title: California sues OpenAI over hacking risks
entry.summary: The state's attorney general started investigating OpenAI after the Hugging Face attack and now says this attack was "entirely foreseeable" due to OpenAI's poor security practices.

entry.title: If Robert Pattinson is James Bond, 007 needs to get a little weird
entry.summary: Amazon announced Monday that Robert Pattinson will be the next James Bond. NPR critic Glen Weldon says the idiosyncratic actor would seem to be a better fit as a Bond villain.
